fact: Fondation Bangui Hub says it was created in 2023 as the first incubator for youth and diaspora in the Central African Republic and has trained over 300 entrepreneurs.
AfDB says Bangui has an equipped, operational digital training centre for 50 trainees with a 3D printer, used to prototype young people's inventions, with no incubation programme or cohort described.

President Touadéra inaugurated a digital training centre with an incubator at the University of Bangui on 15 January 2024, financed by the EU and the African Development Bank; no incubation programme is described.
